source_snapshot.criteria: No error log; normal reboot without hang/crash; changed setting still exists.
source_snapshot.script: No script. Five minutes attended and five machine minutes.

historical_reviews.deepseek: Correct about manual BIOS interaction but incomplete because repeatable post-boot/log verification can be automated and the random-setting instruction is unsafe.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Changes to a hybrid REQUIRES classification with exact setting/value, reboot, persistence, recovery and restoration controls.
historical_reviews.history: No prior V3.1 record or duplicate active variant was found for this source identity.
historical_reviews.v3_1: Retains the source persistence and no-error intent while explicitly rejecting random selection and separating engineer actions from automatable health evidence.

original_test_intent: Verify that one controlled non-default BIOS setting persists across Save and reboot, the host returns normally without new errors, and the original value can be restored.
original_method: Replace random choice with one owner-approved reversible option, record original/alternate values, change only that option in Setup, save/reboot, re-enter Setup to verify persistence, automate host/BMC/log checks, then restore and verify baseline.
manual_activity: An engineer must select the safe option, perform the Setup change/save/reboot and visually verify persistence; the agent may collect post-boot identity, reachability and preserved error-log evidence.
required_inputs: Exact host/console and BIOS menu identity
Approved reversible option with original/alternate values
Validated pre-OS input/capture and independent OOB recovery
Maintenance window, workload clearance and save/reboot/restore approval
safety_requirements: Exclude boot/security/storage/network/power controls unless specifically authorized
Capture baseline and change only one option
Stop on unrelated configuration diff, prompt, hang or loss of access
Preserve rather than clear evidence logs
No automatic retry or hardware PASS claim
agent_execution_scope: Verify supplied identity, option and value contract
Capture read-only host/BMC health before and after engineer actions
Collect boot, OS and SEL evidence without clearing it
Report observations without changing BIOS or deciding PASS/FAIL
engineer_actions: Approve the option, alternate value and recovery
Restore original value and verify baseline

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Correctly rejects SSH-only execution but incorrectly treats the whole case as non-agent work; post-boot health/log collection is automatable.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use the operator workflow for the exact approved BIOS option, with project-standard read-only host/BMC/log collection around both reboot transitions.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: One non-default persistence transition, save/reboot, re-entry and 5/5-minute timing are retained; only unsafe random selection is constrained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use a low-impact allowlisted setting and store a timestamped before/alternate/persisted/restored configuration chain plus automated reboot-health evidence.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Replaces random selection with an approved deterministic option and adds restoration plus machine-collected health evidence.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No loss of persistence or reboot coverage; unbounded random-setting coverage is rejected as unsafe rather than claimed.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Even an apparently low-impact setting may have platform dependencies and Setup changes remain manual.

project_override_considerations: The project must name the option and values. It may approve more than one option only as an explicit matrix with independent rollback, never as an unbounded random selection.
expected_evidence: Approved option path with original/alternate values
Baseline configuration, workload status, approval and recovery readiness
Automated host/BMC reachability and preserved OS/SEL/boot logs
Configuration diff proving no unrelated change
Restored original value and baseline health

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The source consistently asks for persistence and normal reboot; 'random' is unsafe underspecification resolved by a required project input, not a contradiction in test purpose.

blocked_analysis.analysis: A safe option, exact values and recovery can be supplied finitely; their absence requires confirmation but does not make the engineering purpose irreducible.

review_improvement: Eliminates random BIOS mutation while preserving persistence coverage and adds automatable post-reboot health, log and configuration-diff evidence.
independent_technical_reasoning: The pre-OS option change and visual persistence check need an engineer, but host/BMC recovery and error-log evaluation are meaningful automated portions. Therefore this is a hybrid REQUIRES case, not wholly MANUAL ONLY.
